name: Agent guardrails starter (rename the ids to match your own control list)
description: A starting point for mapping AI-agent audit logs to your own controls. Not an official framework mapping and not a certification checklist.

controls.title: Destructive or out-of-scope agent actions are blocked
Data changes made by agents are approved by a named person
Go-live is never approved by an agent
Production deploys by agents are refused or approved by a person
Actions run on Auto are limited to opted-in tools and reviewed
Reports given to reviewers are hash-recorded
